title: E-Talk: Accelerating Active Speaker Detection with Audio-Visual Fusion and Edge-Cloud Computing
motivation: Large-scale surveillance上传海量视频导致网络拥塞,带宽成为瓶颈
problem_framing: 将ASD问题重新建模为边-云协同过滤优化问题,用声纹一致性替代视频序列分析
key_insight: 声纹比对比视频分析更简单轻量,可作为边缘设备speaker切换的判据
method_signature: MFCC+ViBe foreground提取+TalkNet云端脸识别+GMM声纹聚类
evaluation_criteria: mAP检测精度,延迟13.12ms,90%帧过滤率
negative_result_or_admitted_limification: 面部DNN模型在多数情况下脸不可见时准确率低,平均脸检出率仅41.69%
evidence_for_taste: deep network-based algorithms cannot operate in real-time
body crops instead of face crops
speaker is typically the same person
thinking_moves: 把perception问题reframe成communication问题:用声纹一致性过滤替代视频传输
用Pearson相关系数经验筛选特征而非追求最优特征
承认工程约束(脸不可见、算力不足)并绕开而非硬解
